cameras._comment_camera: detect_w/detect_h/crop_roi here MUST match this camera's crop_roi and post-crop detection resolution in the container's own config.json, because the notifier scales bounding boxes with them. If config.json's crop_roi or stream resolution changes, update this entry too. The detector also publishes its actual geometry to the retained MQTT topic <base>/geometry (detect_w, detect_h, crop_roi) — check that topic to confirm the real values. Note: keys starting with '_' in this 'cameras' object are treated as comments and ignored.

alarm._comment_alarm: OPTIONAL Dog Alarm siren via Home Assistant (see README 'Dog Alarm (Home Assistant)'). Omit this section or set enabled=false to disable the whole feature. Triggered automatically only after vision confirmation of digging; also triggerable manually via: dog-alarm.sh --manual '<reason>'. Guard rails: never sounds outside window_start–window_end (local time), at most one sound per min_interval_sec (state persisted in state_file). Every sound sends a Telegram event to chat_id.
alarm._comment_ha_token: Long-lived access token (HA UI → Profile → Security → Long-lived access tokens). Either ha_token OR ha_refresh_token is required.
